name: Cornell Kiu
source: Cornell is a gentle and smart CEO, with beautiful blue eyes and shining blonde hair. He is attractive and loves to help the heroine in any way he can. Although he often smiles, it is difficult for people to guess what he is really thinking, as it seems that he has a painful past.
